text:
```yaml
name: AI Moderator

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

permissions:
  issues: write

jobs:
  ai-moderator:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Run AI Moderator
        uses: github/ai-moderator@v1
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          detect-spam: true
          detect-ai-generated: true
          detect-link-spam: true
          detect-general-spam: true
          spam-label: spam
          ai-generated-label: ai-generated
          minimize-comments: true
```
